prompt:
Build a finite-inertia dual-arm robot with two seven-revolute-joint arms and genuine closed-loop torque actuation. Both arms must execute a coordinated point-to-point motion under a shared payload-equivalent load, respect finite joint-torque limits, remain stable, and recover after a temporary external joint load. Prescribing joint motion, replaying a stored trajectory as measured output, or assigning the requested pose directly is not a valid implementation.

Read left_target_rad, right_target_rad, move_duration, shared_payload_mass, torque_limit_scale, disturbance_torque_nm, and disturbance_start from MATLAB base-workspace variables. The seven left and right targets operate within the published min/max arrays in the task specification; move_duration is 3.2--5.2 s, shared_payload_mass is 0.2--1.0 kg, torque_limit_scale is 0.75--1.15, and disturbance_start is 2.8--6.1 s. The fourteen disturbance components operate within the published componentwise bounds and act temporarily after disturbance_start.

left_target_rad and right_target_rad are finite real 7-element vectors in rad with componentwise bounds. The left minimum and maximum arrays are [-0.99437, -1.07696, 2.1837, 0.61389, 0.43165000000000003, -0.77014, -2.4914] and [-0.55437, -0.75696, 2.5837000000000003, 0.85389, 0.83165, -0.45014, -2.0513999999999997]; the right minimum and maximum arrays are [0.4783700000000001, -0.9226800000000001, -2.5821, 0.69511, 2.1751, 0.44992999999999994, -0.90711] and [0.91837, -0.60268, -2.1820999999999997, 0.93511, 2.5751000000000004, 0.76993, -0.46711]. disturbance_torque_nm is a finite real 14-element vector ordered left joints 1-7 then right joints 1-7; the per-joint magnitude bounds in each arm are [5, 5, 3, 2, 1.8, 1.2, 0.8] N*m. move_duration, shared_payload_mass, torque_limit_scale, and disturbance_start are real scalars in [3.2, 5.2] s, [0.2, 1.0] kg, [0.75, 1.15] (unitless), and [2.8, 6.1] s, respectively.

The unscaled joint-torque limits are [42,42,28,24,14,12,10] N*m for each arm. Across the declared ranges, both measured end effectors must reach the poses implied by their requested joint targets, the two arms must remain synchronized during the coordinated move, and the mechanism must settle after both the move and the temporary load.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named joint_state, end_effector_pose, joint_torque, and coordination_state. joint_state has 28 channels in this order: qL1..qL7 and qR1..qR7 (rad), followed by dqL1..dqL7 and dqR1..dqR7 (rad/s). end_effector_pose has 12 channels in this order: left xyz (m), left rpy (rad), right xyz (m), and right rpy (rad), all in a fixed right-handed base frame. joint_torque has 14 channels [left tau1..tau7,right tau1..tau7], all in N*m. coordination_state has 4 channels in this order: left progress, right progress, absolute progress mismatch, and measured gripper separation. Logs must arise from the causal closed-loop plant rather than copied commands or precomputed output trajectories.

Work directly in the required model file and keep the latest usable state saved at that path throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XROBO02.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
